title: An Adjudicated Result Is Not A Decision Recommendation
summary: A map separating result eligibility, compatibility, independence, contradiction review, triangulation, evidence grading, external challenge, option translation, recommendation, authorization, and reevaluation.
map_question: What decisions remain between an adjudicated result and a bounded, challengeable, reversible decision recommendation?
interpretation_boundary: A result does not become a body of evidence by repetition, a synthesis does not choose policy, and a recommendation does not create authority or an operating outcome. Independence, contradictions, harms, dissent, challenge, sunset, and correction remain explicit.

nodes.label: Adjudicated Phase 73 result
nodes.note: No Phase 73 result has been adjudicated.

nodes.label: Eligible synthesis input
nodes.note: Fourteen gates preserve result identity, scope, uncertainty, adverse evidence, replication, and correction lineage.

nodes.label: Compatibility and independence
nodes.note: Measures, estimands, designs, cohorts, sources, code, operators, and shared assumptions are resolved.

nodes.label: Contradiction register
nodes.note: Ten contradiction categories remain visible and can remain unresolved.

nodes.label: Triangulation and replication portfolio
nodes.note: Independent methods and settings are separated from repeated use of one dependency.

nodes.label: Bounded evidence grade
nodes.note: A qualitative human decision constrains body-level language without scoring or ranking.

nodes.label: External challenge and response
nodes.note: A versioned claim can receive evidence-bound critique, public response, and independent adjudication.

nodes.label: Decision options, harms, and distribution
nodes.note: Action, status quo, benefits, harms, equity, feasibility, capacity, uncertainty, and reversibility are explicit.

nodes.label: Bounded recommendation with dissent
nodes.note: Evidence and values remain separate; conflicts and minority positions stay attached.

nodes.label: Independent decision authority
nodes.note: A recommendation cannot authorize implementation or prove operation.

nodes.label: Monitoring, sunset, and reevaluation
nodes.note: New evidence, adverse events, corrections, challenges, authority changes, and sunset can reopen the decision.

what_this_map_supports: Fourteen result-input gates, fourteen synthesis gates, ten contradiction categories, twelve challenge gates, fourteen translation gates, and ten reevaluation triggers.
Visible separation between result eligibility, compatibility, triangulation, evidence grade, challenge, recommendation, authority, and reevaluation.
Fail-closed correction propagation from a source result through every dependent synthesis and decision artifact.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish an adjudicated result, synthesis, evidence grade, contradiction resolution, challenge outcome, or recommendation.
It does not establish independence, compatibility, transferability, net benefit, legal authority, implementation, adoption, or operating outcome.
It does not create a composite score, rank, forecast, automatic decision, or causal upgrade.
next_records_needed: A real Phase 73 result-adjudication receipt with current correction and withdrawal lineage.
A registered synthesis protocol and at least two eligible results with explicit compatibility and shared-dependency records.
A dual-adjudicated synthesis, open challenge packet, bounded option translation, and sunset rule.
